mapper.sql: INS_NUM, REGI_STD_NUM, REGI_LVL, CHG_DATE, PRI_REGI_NUM, SCD_REGI_NUM, THIR_REGI_NUM, FOUR_REGI_NUM, FIF_REGI_NUM, PRI_REGI_NAME, SCD_REGI_NAME, THIR_REGI_NAME, FOUR_REGI_NAME, FIF_REGI_NAME, DATA_SRC, UPDT_TIME
mapper.select: select CASE WHEN REGI_LVL = 3 THEN THIR_REGI_NUM WHEN REGI_LVL = 2 THEN SCD_REGI_NUM WHEN REGI_LVL = 1 THEN PRI_REGI_NUM ELSE NULL END AS REGI_NUM, CASE WHEN REGI_LVL = 3 THEN concat(concat(PRI_REGI_NAME,SCD_REGI_NAME),THIR_REGI_NAME) WHEN REGI_LVL = 2 THEN concat(PRI_REGI_NAME,SCD_REGI_NAME) WHEN REGI_LVL = 1 THEN PRI_REGI_NAME ELSE NULL END AS REGI_NAME FROM APUB_INFO_INS_REGI WHERE REGI_STD_NUM = #{regionType} AND INS_NUM = #{insNum}

SELECT REGI_MACS_INDX_CLAS_CODE , MACS_INDX_VAL , substr(STAT_END_DATE, 1, 4) AS STAT_END_DATE FROM PUB_REGI_MACS WHERE REGI_CODE = #{regionCode} AND DATA_STAT_FREQ_CODE = '03' AND DATA_SRC ='CH_INF_NEW' AND REGI_MACS_INDX_CLAS_CODE IN () AND STAT_END_DATE LIKE concat((SELECT CASE WHEN LASTDATE>=thisyear-10 THEN LASTDATE ELSE TO_CHAR(thisyear-10) END AS lastdate FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR( max(STAT_END_DATE), 1, 4) AS lastdate ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AS thisyear FROM PUB_REGI_MACS prm WHERE REGI_CODE = #{regionCode} AND DATA_STAT_FREQ_CODE = '03' AND DATA_SRC ='CH_INF_NEW' AND REGI_MACS_INDX_CLAS_CODE IN () )), '%') UNION ALL SELECT REGI_MACS_INDX_CLAS_CODE , MACS_INDX_VAL, substr(STAT_END_DATE, 1, 4) AS STAT_END_DATE FROM PUB_REGI_MACS WHERE REGI_CODE = #{regionCode} AND DATA_STAT_FREQ_CODE = '03' AND DATA_SRC ='CH_INF_NEW' AND REGI_MACS_INDX_CLAS_CODE IN () AND STAT_END_DATE LIKE concat((SELECT CASE WHEN LASTDATE>=thisyear-10 THEN LASTDATE ELSE TO_char(thisyear-10) END -1 AS lastdate FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR( max(STAT_END_DATE), 1, 4) AS lastdate ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AS thisyear FROM PUB_REGI_MACS prm WHERE REGI_CODE = #{regionCode} AND DATA_STAT_FREQ_CODE = '03' AND DATA_SRC ='CH_INF_NEW' AND REGI_MACS_INDX_CLAS_CODE IN () )), '%') UNION ALL SELECT REGI_MACS_INDX_CLAS_CODE , MACS_INDX_VAL, substr(STAT_END_DATE, 1, 4) AS STAT_END_DATE FROM PUB_REGI_MACS WHERE REGI_CODE = #{regionCode} AND DATA_STAT_FREQ_CODE = '03' AND DATA_SRC ='CH_INF_NEW' AND REGI_MACS_INDX_CLAS_CODE IN () AND STAT_END_DATE LIKE concat((SELECT CASE WHEN LASTDATE>=thisyear-10 THEN LASTDATE ELSE TO_char(thisyear-10) END -2 AS lastdate FROM ( SELECT SUBSTR( max(STAT_END_DATE), 1, 4) AS lastdate ,TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') AS thisyear FROM PUB_REGI_MACS prm WHERE REGI_CODE = #{regionCode} AND DATA_STAT_FREQ_CODE = '03' AND DATA_SRC ='CH_INF_NEW' AND REGI_MACS_INDX_CLAS_CODE IN () )), '%')
